# OBS003 `block-data`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A `block data` program unit.

## Why

`block data` exists only to initialise common blocks and is obsolescent since Fortran 2018.
Initialise module variables in their module instead.

## Reported

```fortran
block data init
```

## Preferred

```fortran
module state
  real :: t = 0.0
end module state
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS003] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS003` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `OB013` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
